# Decision log

<!-- Generated by `python -m writeup.report_phase9` from the results files; do not edit by hand. -->

Each major decision with its date, the evidence, the alternative rejected, and the commit that holds it.

| Date | Decision | Evidence | Rejected | Commit |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 2026-10-17 | Cap remaining life at 125 cycles | sensors are flat for most of a life and drift only near failure (EDA) | no cap (asks the model to predict the unpredictable) | `8223226` |
| 2026-10-17 | Split by engine, never by row | rows from one engine are near-copies; a row split leaks the answer | random row split | `8223226` |
| 2026-10-18 | Choose models on validation only, test once | validation near-failure error decided XGBoost over Ridge | choosing on the test set | `b280d0b` |
| 2026-10-18 | Switch the published model from XGBoost to the LSTM | pre-registered pooled test: LSTM better by 2.31 cycles RMSE, Holm p 0.007; 7 of 8 tests significant | switching on FD001 alone (gap not significant there) | `e00eaac, da9eb3d` |
| 2026-10-18 | Interval rule E: two scale factors switched on predicted remaining life | chosen on FD001 validation before FD003 was touched | one scale factor (82% FD003 coverage) | `db8bf1b` |
| 2026-10-20 | Alert on the interval's lower bound at 20 cycles | acting on the pessimistic edge keeps late failures rare | alert on the point forecast | `7e6761e` |
| 2026-10-20 | Threshold 30 NOT adopted | it looked better on the test replay, so adopting it would be tuning to the test set | threshold 30 | `7e6761e` |
| 2026-10-23 | Retraining when rolling RMSE exceeds 1.45x validation RMSE | 1.3x raised too many false alarms on validation windows | the guide's 30% rule | `cce5187` |
| 2026-10-24 | Phase 7b criteria and rule v2 pre-registered | Phase 7's drift test missed its target on clean data | re-tuning Phase 7's rule on the test replay | `ce5a16e, b7b0cb2` |
| 2026-10-24 | Rule v2.1 (log-scale spread) labelled post hoc | fixed a real defect found after the results; FD004 still failed | presenting it as pre-registered | `9cd577c` |
| 2026-10-31 | Dashboards read frozen snapshots with a checksum | the public app needs no database or credentials and is checkable | a live database connection from the cloud | `8fe0ad9` |
| 2026-11-03 | Write-up generated from results files and pre-registered | no number can drift from its source | hand-written docs | `b0a5b95` |
